title: Payment Extension Energy Assistance Relief Schedule
content:
# Payment Extension Energy Assistance Relief Schedule

**Schedule.** For a Payment Extension — the single-installment kind of Payment Arrangement — enrolled on a residential agreement under disconnection notice, the assistance relief is:

| Payments from an energy assistance agency posted to any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements within the 12 months before enrollment | Assistance relief |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 6% |
| Exactly one | 3% |
| None | 0 |

The payments counted are those on the payment records of all of the customer's Electric Service Agreements whose channel is an energy assistance agency. A window of 12 months before enrollment covers payments posted after the same calendar day 12 months earlier, up to and including the enrollment date.

## Readings (hypothetical enrollment dated April 14)

| Agency payments posted | Inside the window (after April 14 of the previous year) | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| April 14 of the previous year and January 20 | One | 3% |
| May 2 of the previous year and January 20 | Two | 6% |
